notes: National registration portal for unorganised workers launched

notes: Dedicated gig and platform worker registration category added to eShram

policy_name: Rajasthan Platform Based Gig Workers Registration and Welfare Act 2023
notes: India's first dedicated gig worker welfare law

policy_name: Rajasthan Gig Workers Act Gazette Notification
notes: Welfare Board, mandatory registration, welfare fund, accident insurance, grievance redressal, fines up to Rs 5 lakh

policy_name: Tamil Nadu Welfare Board Extension to Platform Workers
notes: Not a standalone gig law. Existing welfare board protections extended to include platform and gig workers

policy_name: Bihar Platform-Based Gig Workers (Registration Safety and Welfare) Act 2025
notes: Passed May 2025. Gazette July 24 2025. Compensation schemes active

policy_name: Bihar Gig Workers Act Gazette Notification
notes: Unique IDs, maternity leave, accident compensation Rs 4 lakh, disability and hospitalization aid, welfare fund

policy_name: Karnataka Gig Workers Ordinance
notes: Ordinance approved May 2025. Included welfare fee collection from platforms like Swiggy and Uber

policy_name: Karnataka Platform-Based Gig Workers (Social Security and Welfare) Act 2025
notes: Full welfare law passed after ordinance. Governor assent Sept 11 2025

policy_name: Karnataka Gig Workers Act Gazette Notification
notes: Gazette Sept 12 2025. Welfare Board, mandatory registration, algorithm transparency, grievance via IPGRS

policy_name: Karnataka Gig Workers Grievance System Operational
notes: Grievance redressal system live May 1 2026

policy_name: Jharkhand Platform Based Gig Workers Bill 2025
notes: Passed August 2025

policy_name: Jharkhand Gig Workers Act Governor Assent
notes: Governor assent Dec 13 2025

policy_name: Jharkhand Gig Workers Act Gazette Notification
notes: Gazette Jan 6 2026. Welfare Board, minimum wages, insurance, maternity benefits, penalties up to Rs 10 lakh

policy_name: Telangana Gig Workers Bill
notes: Bill introduced 2025 in assembly

policy_name: Telangana Comprehensive Gig Workers Welfare Act 2026
notes: Passed and approved March-May 2026. Became 5th Indian state with dedicated gig workers act. Registration, welfare board, social security schemes

policy_name: Maharashtra Gig Worker Protection Draft Proposal
notes: Government discussions and draft proposals 2025-26. Health insurance and worker registration schemes under consideration

policy_name: Gujarat Gig Worker Welfare Board Proposal
notes: State government considering welfare board and welfare fund proposals in 2026

policy_name: Kerala Gig Worker Policy Discussions
notes: Ongoing policy discussions and labour-code implementation affecting gig workers. No formal Act or Bill yet

policy_name: Delhi Gig Worker Policy Initiatives
notes: Ongoing policy discussions and labour-code implementation. Exploring welfare schemes and registration drives. No formal Act yet

policy_name: Code on Social Security Still Not Enforced
notes: Despite 6 years since passing, central law remains unenforced as of May 2026
